questions.question: In a pie chart of 40 learners, half chose oranges, a quarter chose apples and an eighth chose bananas. How many chose each fruit?
questions.expected_answer: Half of 40 is 20, so 20 chose oranges. A quarter of 40 is 10 apples, and an eighth of 40 is 5 bananas.

questions.question: The rainfall graph shows 80 mm in March and 50 mm in April. What can you say?
questions.expected_answer: March was wetter than April. It had 30 mm more rain.

questions.question: A graph's scale starts at 50 instead of 0. Why should you read it carefully?
questions.expected_answer: Starting at 50 makes small differences look much bigger. Read the actual numbers on the scale before you compare the bars.
